This document
outlines the inspection checklist I2, which 
must be carried out on an annually basesas 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block. 
The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 11 Aug 2002 for charger no.1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, Cairo zone.

Input voltage 3*380 v AC, 
Output voltage 220 v DC, Output current 50A DC

Input voltage tolerance + 
15%, Input frequency tolerance + 5%

Wearing goggles, safety shoes, helmet, and rubber gloves 
 is necessary

items:
Work order must be issuedand 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Transfer the 
 battery to the standby charger

Check 
 ventilation system, and grease exhausting fans bearings,

Check contacts 
 and terminals and tighten it,

Check control 
 board for overheating components,

Check SCR, ECU 
 and diodes visually,

Clean transfer 
 switches (mode switch, voltage switch, etc )

Clean relays 
 (low voltage relay, fault indicating relay, ..etc .. using spray liquid free 
 of oil, video cleaner)

Then switch on 
 power supply and measure the operation FLOAT voltage using digital DC 
 voltmeter (must be 245V + 1%), if the values of measured voltage are 
 below or above the standard values as in brackets, you can adjust it 
 accurately by FLOAT control potentiometer P3 in the upper electronic control 
 unit as indicated by the following steps:
 1- Put the mode switch S1 on FLOAT position.
 2- Increase the floating voltage by turning the FLOAT potentiometer 
 P3 clockwise
 3- Decrease the floating voltage by turning the FLOAT potentiometer 
 P3 anticlockwise.
 4- Repeat steps no. 2, 3 until get the desired value.

Measure the HI Rate charging using digital DC voltmeter (must be 253.75V + 
 1%), if the values of measured voltage are below or above the standard values 
 as in brackets, you can adjust it accurately by HI-Rate potentiometer P1 in 
 the upper electronic control unit SCR, ECU, as indicated by the following 
 steps:
 1- Put the mode switch S1 on HI-Rate position.
 2- Increase the HI-Rate voltage by turning the HI-Rate potentiometer P1 
 clockwise
 3- Decrease the floating voltage by turning the HI-Rate potentiometer P1 
 anticlockwise.
 4- Repeat steps no. 2, 3 until get the desired value.

Substations
Technical Procedure
Equipment
 Battery Charger 
 3PF-2-60
Introduction
This document
outlines the inspection checklist I2, which 
must be carried out on an annually basesas 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block. 
The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 11 Aug 2002 for charger no.1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, Cairo zone.
The Charger technical data:
Input voltage 3*380 v AC, 
Output voltage 220 v DC, Output current 50A DC
Input voltage tolerance + 
15%, Input frequency tolerance + 5%
Safety 
Precautions
Switch off the power supply,
No smoking is permitted,
Wearing goggles, safety shoes, helmet, and rubber gloves 
 is necessary
Work order must be issuedand 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Tools and Equipments
Digital voltmeter
Suitable tool 
 set
Vacuum Cleaner or blower
Brush
Work to be carried out
Transfer the 
 battery to the standby charger
Disconnect the 
 power supply.
Check 
 ventilation system, and grease exhausting fans bearings,
Check fuses,
Check contacts 
 and terminals and tighten it,
Check control 
 board for overheating components,
Check SCR, ECU 
 and diodes visually,
Clean transfer 
 switches (mode switch, voltage switch, etc )
Clean relays 
 (low voltage relay, fault indicating relay, ..etc .. using spray liquid free 
 of oil, video cleaner)
Then switch on 
 power supply and measure the operation FLOAT voltage using digital DC 
 voltmeter (must be 245V + 1%), if the values of measured voltage are 
 below or above the standard values as in brackets, you can adjust it 
 accurately by FLOAT control potentiometer P3 in the upper electronic control 
 unit as indicated by the following steps:
 1- Put the mode switch S1 on FLOAT position.
 2- Increase the floating voltage by turning the FLOAT potentiometer 
 P3 clockwise
 3- Decrease the floating voltage by turning the FLOAT potentiometer 
 P3 anticlockwise.
 4- Repeat steps no. 2, 3 until get the desired value.
Measure the HI Rate charging using digital DC voltmeter (must be 253.75V + 
 1%), if the values of measured voltage are below or above the standard values 
 as in brackets, you can adjust it accurately by HI-Rate potentiometer P1 in 
 the upper electronic control unit SCR, ECU, as indicated by the following 
 steps:
 1- Put the mode switch S1 on HI-Rate position.
 2- Increase the HI-Rate voltage by turning the HI-Rate potentiometer P1 
 clockwise
 3- Decrease the floating voltage by turning the HI-Rate potentiometer P1 
 anticlockwise.
 4- Repeat steps no. 2, 3 until get the desired value.
